title: How do we find three decimal products?
description: Three products are found by taking away the points, multiplying the whole numbers and counting the digits after the point in both numbers together, the same way as the example in the book. A rough size check closes the working before the answers appear.
teaching_notes: One idea: multiply as whole numbers, then place the point so the product has as many digits after it as the two numbers together. Watch for students who forget to add a zero in front when the product has too few digits.

video_script.why: The child has seen that the digits after the point in a product are those of the two numbers added and now uses it on three products.
video_script.substitution: the book's own three products, twenty seven point three four times six, four point two three times three point seven, and zero point four three two times zero point two three
video_script.anchor: Three products from the book to be found by the digit rule

final_answer.spoken: one hundred and sixty four point zero four. Fifteen point six five one. Zero point zero nine nine three six

maths_rules: (c) 432 × 23 = 9936; digits after the point 3 + 2 = 5; 9936 has only 4 digits so a zero is put in front; 0.432 × 0.23 = 0.09936
video_script.design: One idea: take away the points, multiply, and put the point back by counting. Assumes the digit rule. The three products stay all video; the decimals appear only on the answer beat.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Take away the point, and a decimal becomes a whole number.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Multiply the whole numbers first.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Then put the point back by counting the digits after it in both numbers together.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Given, twenty seven point three four times six.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Four point two three times three point seven.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>And zero point four three two times zero point two three.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, solve the same way as the example in your book. For the first product, take away the point.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Two thousand seven hundred and thirty four times six is sixteen thousand four hundred and four.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Twenty seven point three four has two digits after the point, and six has none. Two plus none is two.

marks.m1: the points are taken away from four point two three and three point seven
marks.m3: the digits after the point are counted and added

beats.colours: the digits after the point in the accent colour
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, for the second product, take away the point in each number.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Four hundred and twenty three times thirty seven is fifteen thousand six hundred and fifty one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Four point two three has two digits after the point, and three point seven has one. Two plus one is three.

beats.on_screen: (c) 432 × 23 = 9936; digits after the point: 3 + 2 = 5, but 9936 has only 4 digits

marks.m1: the points are taken away from zero point four three two and zero point two three
marks.m3: the digits are counted and a gap is shown in front of the product

beats.colours: the digits after the point in the accent colour
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, for the third product, take away the point in each number.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Four hundred and thirty two times twenty three is nine thousand nine hundred and thirty six.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Zero point four three two has three digits after the point, and zero point two three has two. That makes five, but the product has only four digits.

marks.m1: twenty seven is multiplied by six
marks.m3: zero point four is multiplied by zero point two

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step four, check the size. Twenty seven times six is one hundred and sixty two.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Four times four is sixteen.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Zero point four times zero point two is zero point zero eight. The answers must be near these.

marks.m2: the first two products are written with the point put back
marks.m3: a zero is put in front of nine nine three six and the third product is written

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Each product is now known.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The first is one hundred and sixty four point zero four. The second is fifteen point six five one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Put a zero in front to make five digits. The third is zero point zero nine nine three six.
